Dear Ms Diggins,

Thank you for your email.

I realise that I made a mistake in my previous email. I inadvertently referred to records "held by the National Library of Wales", when I intended to enquire about material held by Glamorgan Archives.

A member of my family has scheduled a visit to the Search Room tomorrow to research Great House Farm (Ty Mawr/Cedfin/Cydfin), Llandough, and our Williams and Buckler family history. If possible, I would be very grateful if the following material could be prepared in advance.

I appreciate that some references below may relate to connected collections or require confirmation of the correct repository. Where a reference is not held by Glamorgan Archives, we would be grateful if you could advise whether you hold any related material, copies, cross-references or catalogue information, or direct us to the appropriate repository.

The records requested are as follows:

  *   DB/E/1–2 – David Stewart survey of the Marquess of Bute's Glamorgan estates, including Great House Farm alias Cedfin, Llandough, together with any related maps or accompanying material.
  *   D160/1–4 – Agreements between Lambert Williams and the Bute Estate (1818–1835).
  *   Any copies, related material or cross-references connected with NLW D219 (Llandough manorial leases and agreements, including Ty Mawr/Cydfin references).
  *   D153/4–8 – Records relating to the 1876 severance of land formerly part of Great House Farm for Llandough Limeworks, including associated plans.
  *   DSA/6/701 – Parts of the Llandough Estate, 9 October 1924.
  *   DSA/6/1158 – Great House Farm, Llandough, 15 November 1938, including sale particulars, plans and associated papers.
  *   GD/LA/15/255 – Great House Farm sale particulars (1938), if held.
  *   DXJF/64/27–32, including DXJF/64/30–32 – Nancy Buckler / Nancy Buckler Williams sketch and notes of the former layout of Llandough.
  *   DCOWHS material containing references to the Buckler family.
  *   DBDT catalogue reference relating to the July 1877 counterpart lease from the Trustees of the late Marquess of Bute to John Williams, if held.
  *   Cardiff Rural District Council records relating to Great House Farm or Ty Mawr.
  *   CVG/C/1/52.
  *   DCVG/PL planning records relating to Great House Farm, demolition, redevelopment or Church View Close.
  *   Any relevant DRA records, including DRA 418–420 or DRA 5/31.
  *   UDPE/S/1/68 – Original four plans and accompanying documents.
  *   Any estate maps, sale plans, surveys, tithe maps, OS maps or boundary plans showing Great House Farm/Ty Mawr.
  *   Any records relating to Western Ground Rents Ltd, Mountjoy Ltd, BP Pension Trust Ltd, BP Properties Ltd, or any leases, conveyances, rent books, tenancy agreements, possession records or related correspondence concerning Great House Farm and the Williams/Buckler family.

If any of the above records contain associated bundles, schedules, enclosures, oversized plans or documents stored separately from the principal reference, we would be grateful if these could also be identified.

We would also appreciate advice as to whether Glamorgan Archives holds any uncatalogued or recently deposited material relating to Great House Farm, Ty Mawr, the above families, or the ownership and occupation history of the site between 1875 and 1988.

My reader's ticket number is 2004093.

Thank you very much for your assistance.

Kind regards,



Requester

Under the Freedom of Information Act 2000 I request the following recorded information held by the National Library of Wales:
Any manorial court rolls, surveys, rentals, terriers, or related documents for the Manor of Llandough (Glamorgan) covering the period c.1600–1670 that list or refer to occupants, customary tenants, or holders of land later known as Great House Farm (or equivalent contemporary descriptions).
Any estate papers, correspondence, leases, rentals, account books, or surveys of the Vaughan family of Llandough (or related Vaughan holdings) that mention a lease, renewal, confirmation, surrender, or new grant of land at Great House Farm / Llandough around or before 1667.
Any catalogue descriptions, finding aids, or indexes that identify pre-1667 deeds, court-roll entries, or estate surveys referring to the family’s holding at this property.
Please confirm whether such material is held and, if so, provide the relevant catalogue references and any available descriptions or copies (or advise on access arrangements). If any information is exempt, please state the exemption(s) relied upon.

Yours faithfully,

Requester
